Use case: historical-scene. Generate ONE completely NEW bright photorealistic COLOR PHOTOGRAPH, portrait3:4,1086x1448. This is a fresh whole photograph, never a local retouch. The single supplied image is ONLY the exact porcelain object identity reference; retain its shape, decorations and low base.
Scene: Qing imperial palace corridor. Exactly two adult eunuchs in dark navy Qing round-neck silk robes, black court skullcaps and long braids approach the camera together carrying the intact large yellow vase WITH its low pedestal, securely supporting opposite sides of the pedestal with their hands. Puyi, an approximately8-year-old Chinese boy in an embroidered yellow Qing robe and black skullcap with small gold knob, walks a few steps ahead. They carry the vase into a bright reception hall as a birthday decoration. Camera directly in FRONT from the end of the corridor, all three full bodies and their feet in frame, realistic candid slow walking, no one posing for camera. Red lacquer columns, gilded carved timber, pale daylight and polished stone floor; no other people in background.
Object: exact reference yellow double-gourd vase with large round lower globe, narrow waist, smaller upper body and slender flaring neck, two curled TURQUOISE handles, pink peonies and green foliage, turquoise/red painted bands. Same LOW yellow round pedestal with turquoise ring and curled feet directly under the vase. Total vase+base approximately1meter tall; sensible scale against adults. Preserve the specific reference decoration, not a different vase.
HIGHEST PRIORITY — AUTHENTIC CLOTH FOOTWEAR FOR ALL THREE PEOPLE: Both eunuchs wear traditional Qing BLACK CALF-HIGH CLOTH BOOTS, matte woven black fabric shafts and rounded sewn cloth toes, on THICK FLAT WHITE LAYERED CLOTH SOLES. These are hand-stitched cloth soles with straight continuous edges, not molded foam or rubber. Show a section of each boot shaft below the robe hems so they read unmistakably as historical BOOTS. Puyi wears small traditional embroidered golden-yellow SILK/CLOTH ankle boots with floral needlework and fine flat light-colored sewn cloth soles, visibly matching his robe. Show BOTH feet of EACH person clearly separated, six feet total, with uncluttered floor beneath them. Hems end just above footwear; no feet cropped or hidden behind the vase or another person. Natural gentle steps, no exaggerated raised soles toward the camera.
Absolutely NO sneakers, trainers, sports shoes, laces, athletic logos, rubber toe caps, thick curved foam midsoles, grippy modern outsoles, modern clothes or modern objects anywhere. Do not make footwear look like a modern shoe dressed in silk. Period textiles and sewn cloth construction must be evident.
Style: luminous realistic camera photograph with natural skin, delicate silk texture, believable glazed porcelain reflections and grounded contact shadows. Soft daytime light, warm but restrained colors, authentic photographic surface. No CGI, painting effect, patterned artificial skin, impossible hands, captions, writing, graphic borders, oval masks, signatures, stars, corner badges or watermarks.
